# Bug audit — 29 Oct 2026

_Moved here on 2026-11-04 from the old `code/docs/` folder, unchanged except links. Written before the build-note format
existed, so its headings differ; the format is in [README.md](README.md)._

Scope: the mobile app (`frontend/apps/mobile`) and the backend (`backend`). The web app is out of scope.
Bugs B1–B9 were found and written down before anything was fixed; B10 turned up while fixing B5. The **Status** column records what happened afterwards.

## How the audit was done
| Check | Result |
|-------|--------|
| Backend type check (`tsc --noEmit`) | Clean |
| Backend unit tests (`jest --config test/jest-unit.json`) | 80 / 80 pass |
| Backend lint (`eslint`, no auto-fix) | 29 findings: 26 formatting (prettier), 3 minor; no logic errors |
| Mobile type check | Clean |
| Backend ownership checks, spot-checked: food reservations, notifications read/delete, story comment delete, messaging member status | All correct; no access-control bugs found in the sample |
| Runtime logs (Metro, backend) | One backend route warning (B9) |
| Walk-through on the Android phone (Expo Go, local backend) | Listings, listing detail, Rooms & Mates, Messages, Explore, Food, Community |
| Targeted code reading | The code behind every glitch seen on the phone, plus pattern greps for raw dates and timers |

The audit is not exhaustive. All 24 backend modules exist, but only the paths listed above were read
closely. These were not exercised because the local database has no data for them: events, quests,
polls, stories with real content, property applications, the admin screens.

## Bugs found

| # | Severity | Area | Bug | Where | Status |
|---|----------|------|-----|-------|--------|
| B1 | High | Rooms & Mates | **"Move-in Soon" roommate filter never matches anyone.** It keeps a roommate only if the move-in text is `"Immediate"` or contains `"Mar"` (hard-coded March). Move-in dates are ISO strings such as `2026-11-02`, so the list comes out empty, or matches by accident only for March dates. | `app/(tabs)/housing/index.tsx` (roommate filter) || **Fixed.** Filter keeps people moving in within 30 days (or already able to), soonest first. Phone: 3 of 12 test roommates now match; before, none did. |
| B2 | Medium | Messages | **"✓✓" (read) ticks on every conversation without unread messages**, including ones with no messages at all ("✓✓ No messages yet") and ones where the *other* person sent the last message. | `app/chat.tsx` list row, `src/api/chat.api.ts` || **Fixed.** Ticks show only when the current user sent the last message. Phone: gone from the "No messages yet" row. |
| B3 | Medium | Messages | **"No conversations yet" empty state shows while the list is still loading**, below the spinner, so people with conversations briefly see "no conversations". | `app/chat.tsx` (`ListEmptyComponent`) || **Fixed.** Empty state hidden while loading. Verified in code only; the list loaded too fast on the phone to catch the loading state. |
| B4 | Medium | Stories | **Pausing a photo story restarts its timer.** Holding to pause, or opening comments, then releasing sends the progress bar back to 0, so the photo plays again from the start. | `app/story-viewer.tsx` (photo progress interval) || **Fixed.** Progress is remembered per story and resumes after a pause. Verified in code only; there are no stories in the local data. |
| B5 | Medium | Rooms & Mates | **Raw ISO dates on roommate cards and the profile modal** (`2026-11-02`), and on shared-room cards ("From 2026-…"), instead of a readable date. | `src/features/housing/roommateModel.ts` || **Fixed.** Shown as "Nov 2, 2026" / "Immediate" / "Flexible"; shared rooms show "Available now" or "From Nov 2, 2026". Phone: roommate card verified. |
| B6 | Low | Listings | **"🚶 Walk 0" in red and "🚇 N/A" pills** on every listing card without walk-score/transit data. The empty data reads like a terrible score. | `src/features/housing/components/ListingCard.tsx` || **Fixed.** Each pill appears only when there is data. Phone: verified. |
| B7 | Low | Listings | **Floor ordinal is always "th"**: "1th Floor", "2th Floor", "3th Floor", "21th Floor". Floor 0 (ground) shows "N/A". | `src/features/housing/listingModel.ts` || **Fixed.** 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 11th–13th, 21st…; 0 shows "Ground Floor" ("G" in the card grid); text floors pass through. Checked with sample values; the test listings have no floor. |
| B8 | Low | Rooms & Mates | **Match-score sort can go stale**: the roommate list `useMemo` reads the signed-in user for the client-side match score but doesn't list `user` as a dependency. Only affects roommates without a server score. | `app/(tabs)/housing/index.tsx` || **Fixed.** `user` added to the dependencies. |
| B9 | Low | Backend | **Legacy wildcard route** `forRoutes('*')` logs `LegacyRouteConverter: Unsupported route path "/api/*"` on every start. Nest converts it automatically today, but the syntax is deprecated in path-to-regexp v8. | `backend/src/app.module.ts` || **Fixed.** `forRoutes('{*path}')`. Backend restarted: no warning; request logging still works; 80/80 unit tests pass. |
| B10 | Medium | Listings, Rooms & Mates | **Dates shifted a day by time zone** (found while fixing B5). Availability/move-in dates are stored as `YYYY-MM-DD` at UTC midnight, and the app turned them into local time: a Nov 2 move-in showed as **Nov 1** anywhere west of UTC (for example Los Angeles, the default city), and test values with a time showed as **Nov 3** in India. | `src/features/housing/listingModel.ts` (`formatAvailability`) | **Fixed.** Dates are read from the date part only (`parseCalendarDate`). Phone (IST): shows Nov 2, matching the stored date. |

### Noted, not changed
- **Errors hidden in dev:** `app/_layout.tsx` ignores every `Uncaught (in promise` warning in LogBox, which hides unhandled API errors during development. Removing the ignore would surface many existing warnings, so it's a decision for the team rather than a bug fix.
- **"Available" badge on listing detail** describes the listing's status (listed, not rented), not its move-in date. A listing available from December still shows "Available". It's arguably correct; worth a product decision.
- **Seed data inconsistencies**: a "3BR" title on a 1-bed listing, and every roommate at a 20% match. These come from the local test data I seeded, not from the app.
